revision_summary: One quote fix and one interpretive overreach need correction before this ships. (1) Minor quote fix: state_changes[1] cites '07:26' for 'Yeah. It's just a superpower...' — the actual line is at 07:27 and the rep's phrasing is broken up ('...when you reach Yes. Right. Age there. Age. Age. Yeah. Yeah.'), not the clean sentence quoted. Fix timestamp and quote fidelity. (2) The 03:05 quote ('if you don't think they can do it, I'm not interested if they can't') is used as the anchor for a priority-2 coaching_focus item and a handoff_brief 'hard condition for moving forward' claim, both pointing at the solar/transformer capability question — but sequentially the quote comes right before the customer introduces the SECURITY SYSTEM topic (03:21), not the transformer/outbuilding topic (04:46+). This is a plausible but not clearly grounded attribution. Revise to either (a) note both possible referents with appropriate hedged confidence, or (b) demote this from priority-2 coaching_focus / hard-gate framing in the handoff brief to a lower-confidence flag, since sending a closer in believing there's a confirmed hard gate on a specific technical point that may not be what the customer was actually gating on could misdirect the close. Additionally, cherry_pick_moments[3]'s framing of the 04:16 rep line as a missed response to the 82-years-old/principle framing is chronologically backwards (04:16 precedes 04:20) — reframe as the rep's generic money-motive line prompting the customer's self-clarification, not the rep failing to respond to something not yet said. Also fix schema references: the 05:00 prior-contact moment should cite verify.prior_designs and/or analysis_directives.handoff_brief_generation rather than knowledge_gap_handling, which is about reps lacking answers to direct questions, not about failing to probe a customer's own disclosure.
